name: TickTrash Bulk
author: titandevagency

sections.description:
TickTrash Bulk lets you safely bulk delete posts, pages, comments, users, taxonomy terms, metadata, and more with preview, confirmation, and batch processing.

Features:

  • Posts — Bulk delete posts, pages and custom post types by post type, status, published or modified date, title, content, author, taxonomy, custom fields, URL, comment count, content length (words/characters), specific post IDs, duplicate titles, and custom query
  • Comments — Bulk delete or trash comments by status, type, author, age, and post ID
  • Users — Bulk delete users by role, registration date, username, email, display name, and user meta. Current account and Super Admins are always protected
  • Taxonomy Terms — Bulk delete categories, tags, and custom taxonomy terms by name, slug, description, parent, usage count, and term meta. Associated posts are never deleted
  • Metadata — Clean up post, user, comment, and term metadata by key, value, and object filters
  • Cleanup — Remove revisions, auto-drafts, trashed content, spam comments, orphaned metadata, and duplicate metadata (post, comment, term, and user)
  • Activity Logs — Full audit trail of every deletion operation with filters and detail view
  • Scheduler — Schedule recurring cleanup tasks with WordPress Cron (hourly, daily, twice daily, weekly, monthly)

Safety features:

  • Preview matching records before any deletion
  • Batch processing to avoid timeouts on large datasets
  • Progress bar with real-time stats
  • Permanent delete or move to trash (where applicable)
  • Full nonce verification and capability checks
  • Protected accounts (current user, Super Admins) can never be deleted
  • Comprehensive activity logging

All features are completely free. No pro version, no locked features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ticktrash-bulk folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to TickTrash Bulk in the admin sidebar.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. All features are free with no pro version or locked functionality.

Does deletion happen in batches?

Yes. Records are processed in batches of 100 by default to prevent PHP timeouts and memory issues.

Does it support WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce-specific cleanup is planned for a future update and is not included in this version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Plugin renamed to TickTrash Bulk (slug: ticktrash-bulk).
  • Unique ttbulk_ prefix for all functions, classes, constants, options, database table, cron hook, AJAX actions, script handles and CSS classes.

1.0.1

  • Final WordPress.org-ready release.
  • Corrected LICENSE file to match the declared GPLv2-or-later license.
  • Removed unused empty WooCommerce placeholder files and version-control metadata from the package.
  • Updated “Tested up to” and added “Requires PHP” header.
  • Added content word/character count, post ID, modified date, duplicate posts, and custom query filters for posts.
  • Added taxonomy term meta filtering.
  • Added monthly scheduling recurrence.
  • Added duplicate metadata cleanup for post, comment, term, and user meta.
  • Improved trash handling to use wp_trash_post and preserve attachments in non-permanent deletions.
  • Improved scheduler reliability with time budget, excluded-ID tracking, and narrowing validation.
  • Added snapshot-based deletion so the live filters cannot change after confirmation.
  • Removed all development-only test data generator and test/audit scripts from the package.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Posts bulk deletion with post type, status, date, title, content, author, taxonomy, meta, URL, and comment count filters.
  • Comments bulk deletion/trash with status, type, author, age, and post ID filters.
  • Users bulk deletion with role, registration date, username, email, display name, and meta filters.
  • Taxonomy terms bulk deletion with name, slug, description, parent, and usage filters.
  • Metadata cleanup for post, user, comment, and term meta.
  • WordPress cleanup for revisions, auto-drafts, trashed content, spam comments, and orphaned metadata.
  • Activity logs with filtering and detail view.
  • Scheduler with hourly, daily, twice daily, and weekly recurrence options.
  • Preview, confirmation, and batch processing with progress bar.
